picks.thesis: Tape is modestly risk-off (SPY -0.45%, VXX +1.4%) but leadership rotation favors energy and memory/semis; crypto proxies (COIN +6.5%, MSTR +6.9%) are front-running spot — I stay positioned, add defined-risk NVDA earnings exposure and a small BTC catch-up long.
picks.justification: Core book is working: MU +2% on memory pricing strength, XLE confirmed by XOM/CVX bids, and the XLY short is paying as discretionary rolls over post-WMT guidance shock. WMT itself gapped -9% but my entry is post-crash; I hold the mean-reversion with a tight stop rather than sell into the flush. New risk is small and catalyst-driven: an NVDA call into earnings week caps downside at premium while capturing a beat, and COIN/MSTR ripping 6-7% while BTC sits flat is a flow divergence that historically resolves with spot following — I take BTC, not the levered proxies I'd be chasing.

positions.thesis: Hold core into earnings; AI capex demand intact and hyperscaler guides confirm order visibility.
HBM/DRAM pricing cycle accelerating — +2% today on sector strength confirms trend; ride the momentum.
Cheapest mega-cap AI compounder; -1.3% dip is market beta, not thesis damage.
Energy leading a red tape (XOM +1.9%, CVX +1.2%) — under-owned sector with momentum and yield support.
ETH basing at 2300 while equity crypto proxies rally hard — flow leads spot; hold for catch-up move.
High-beta crypto exposure at compressed levels; moves 1.5-2x ETH on a risk bid.
Entered post-9% guidance flush; quality defensive staple, mean-reversion bounce with a hard stop below the gap low.
Consumer discretionary cracking — WMT guide-down, NKE/F/SBUX all red; short is working, let it run.
COIN +6.5% and MSTR +6.9% with spot BTC flat — proxy flow divergence typically resolves with spot following within days.
Defined-risk earnings play: max loss is premium, a typical post-beat 5-8% move multiplies it; asymmetry justifies paying elevated IV.

picks.thesis: Broad risk assets are soft, but relative strength in crypto-linked flows, select semiconductors, and energy supports a focused long book with cash reserved for confirmation.
picks.justification: Hold BTC, ETH, SOL, AVGO, TSM, MRVL, QCOM, and XLE because their themes remain intact and most are outperforming their benchmarks today. Exit AMD due to relative weakness within semiconductors and excessive overlap with stronger holdings. Open no new position and retain 17% cash rather than chase sharp moves in COIN, MSTR, DE, or the WMT selloff.

positions.thesis: Spot BTC offers cleaner crypto upside than the already-surging equity proxies while holding near the current base.
ETH provides higher-beta participation if crypto risk appetite broadens beyond BTC.
SOL supplies asymmetric upside in a crypto expansion while a firm stop contains its higher volatility.
AVGO is showing relative strength against a declining technology tape and retains AI infrastructure exposure.
TSM is outperforming QQQ today and remains the foundational manufacturing exposure for advanced compute demand.
MRVL's strong relative momentum signals continued demand for its networking and custom silicon exposure.
QCOM is outperforming the broad technology market and offers diversified edge-AI exposure.
Energy strength and rising integrated-oil shares provide diversification from the crypto and semiconductor risk cluster.
